summary: Comprehensive E2E testing of Buland Bharat Party MVP. Backend pytest suite (24 tests across auth, membership, news CRUD, leaders, contact) passed 100%. Frontend Playwright suite (home load, language toggle, navigation, news detail, join form submission, contact page, protected admin route, admin login wrong+correct, dashboard tabs, news CRUD via admin UI, memberships table, logout, mobile menu) passed 100%. Hindi UTF-8 storage verified end-to-end. No critical issues found.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout / rate limiting implemented (playbook recommends lockout after 5 fails). Acceptable for MVP but flag for production hardening.
Returns JWT in body only (no httpOnly cookie). Token is stored in localStorage on frontend (bbp_token) which is XSS-exposed. Acceptable for MVP.
CORS_ORIGINS is '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject; works only because frontend uses Bearer header (not cookies). Tighten origins for production.
FastAPI on_event startup/shutdown is deprecated; migrate to lifespan context manager.

action_items: Optional production hardening: add brute-force lockout, move JWT to httpOnly cookie, scope CORS origins, migrate to lifespan handlers.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth: bcrypt hash format correct ($2b$), seed_admin idempotent and updates password if changed — good.
All endpoints exclude MongoDB _id with projection {'_id':0} or doc.pop('_id', None) — no ObjectId leakage observed in any response.
Pydantic validation enforced on all POST/PUT bodies (422 on invalid payloads).
Frontend uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exclusively; no hardcoded URLs.
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes — excellent testability.
server.py is ~430 lines — still within healthy size but approaching threshold; consider splitting routers (auth, news, membership, contact, leaders) if scope grows.
test_credentials: admin@bulandbharat.in / BulandBharat@2025 (seeded on backend startup; verified working).
seed_data_creation: Backend startup seeds 1 admin user, 4 leaders, 3 news articles. Tests created TEST_-prefixed membership (2), news (1, then deleted), contact (1) records — not cleaned up but harmless.
